transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As you know, the metal-fabrication lab has been closed while we prepare a revised operating plan. We now have a draft proposal on the table that would reopen the lab for up to 20 students with standard protective equipment, ordinary end-of-class cleanup, and Ms. Ortiz as the instructor. Before I make a decision on approval, I'd like to follow our normal pre-authorization routine and hear final input from the instructor, our safety officer, the nurse, and our industry-partnership coordinator. Could each of you share any final information or concerns you have about this reopening plan?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to share something important before we proceed. I completed an airflow test on the lab's ventilation system this week, and it found that the current ventilation supports no more than 12 students working in the booths at one time — not 20. I submitted the test to maintenance, but I understand the revised operating-plan folder hasn't been updated with this information yet. This directly affects the draft proposal's capacity of 20 students.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to share the findings from my fire-code review, which I finalized this week. The review requires a hot-work permit for every lab session and a continuous 30-minute fire watch after welding ends. However, I should note that the approval packet still contains only the ordinary cleanup procedure — it has not yet been updated to reflect these fire-code requirements.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to share an important health and safety matter before we proceed. Two students registered for the lab have health plans requiring a powered air-purifying respirator (PAPR) during welding. I confirmed both the health plans and that the school has two compatible PAPR units available this week. However, I have not yet entered this requirement into the lab plan. The draft proposal currently only references standard protective equipment, which would not be sufficient for these two students. This requirement needs to be added to the operating plan before reopening is approved.
transcript.speaker: A4
